claims.description: Native `table` elements and supported table display values create table formatting boxes.

notes.text: Native `table`, `caption`, `colgroup`, `col`, row-group, row, and cell elements plus authored table display values have parity coverage.
The implemented table subset is intentionally narrow and relies on explicit sizing for complex structures.

claims.description: Explicit table, column, row, and cell dimensions participate in supported sizing and spanning.

notes.text: Intrinsic column sizing is not modeled.

claims.description: `border-spacing` and supported collapsed-border geometry affect table layout.

notes.text: Full collapsed-border conflict resolution is not modeled.

claims.description: `caption-side` placement and row-group ordering follow the supported table model.
Supported collapsed visibility and empty-cell behavior affect table geometry and hit testing.

notes.text: Complex table-specific `visibility: collapse` interactions are not modeled.

claims.description: `table-layout` and `vertical-align` hints are accepted without changing the supported geometry subset.

notes.text: `table-layout` and `vertical-align` are parsed as inert declarations.
